settingsCurrencies.title: Currencies
settingsCurrencies.description: What your numbers are reported in, and how the other currencies get there.
settingsCurrencies.baseSaved: Every total is now reported in {currency}.
settingsCurrencies.reportingDescription: Every total, chart and average in the CRM is expressed in this currency. Each deal keeps the currency it was sold in.
settingsCurrencies.reportingHint: Changing this re-converts every deal at today's rates. Figures already reported will move.
settingsCurrencies.reportingOwnerOnly: Only an owner or an admin can change how money is reported.
settingsCurrencies.ratesDescription: How many {currency} one unit of each currency buys. Fetched daily from open.er-api.com; a rate you enter here wins.
settingsCurrencies.rateInvalid: A rate has to be a number greater than zero.
settingsCurrencies.ratesEmpty: No rates yet. Refresh to fetch them, or enter one by hand.
settingsCurrencies.allConvertible: Every deal with an amount can be converted into the reporting currency.
settingsCurrencies.unconverted: {count, plural, one {# deal cannot be converted, so it is left out of every total.} other {# deals cannot be converted, so they are left out of every total.}}
settingsCurrencies.inUseEmpty: No deals have an amount yet.

settingsTracking.title: Tracking & Analytics
settingsTracking.description: Track website visitors and automatically add contacts when a form is submitted.
settingsTracking.rulesDescription: Where the script may run, and how it follows a visitor.

crossDomain.label: Automatic cross-domain linking
crossDomain.hint: Carry the visitor between the domains below, so one journey is not counted as two people

limitToDomains.label: Limit tracking to the domains below
limitToDomains.hint: On any other domain the script loads and then does nothing

cookieSubdomains.label: Limit cookies to subdomains
cookieSubdomains.hint: Set the cookie on the exact host that served the page, never on the parent domain

secureCookies.label: Use secure cookies only
secureCookies.hint: Send the cookie over HTTPS and drop it on plain HTTP

honourDnt.label: Honour Do Not Track
honourDnt.hint: Record nothing at all when the browser asks not to be tracked

settingsTracking.cookiesDescription: How a returning visitor is recognised.
settingsTracking.lifetimeDescription: After this a returning visitor counts as somebody new. Shorten it if your policy asks you to.
settingsTracking.sourcesDescription: Where your visitors come from. Only people who have submitted a form are attributed to a record.
settingsTracking.sourcesEmpty: No sources yet. They appear once the script records its first page view.
settingsTracking.pausedToast: Tracking paused. The script stops recording within five minutes.
settingsTracking.rotatedToast: Site ID rotated. Paste the new tag on your website.
settingsTracking.copyUnavailable: Could not copy the script. Select it instead.
settingsTracking.scriptDescription: One tag, 4 KB, in the head of every page you measure.
settingsTracking.siteIdHint: Site ID <mono>{siteId}</mono> · Rotating it stops every copy of the old script at once.
settingsTracking.gtmTrigger: Add it through Google Tag Manager
settingsTracking.gtmStep1: In Tag Manager, add a new Custom HTML tag.
settingsTracking.gtmStep2: Paste this snippet — not the one above — as the tag's HTML.
settingsTracking.gtmStep3: Trigger it on All Pages, then publish the container. Keep <mono>{url}</mono> off any consent-blocked category you do not need.
settingsTracking.gtmNote: Tag Manager drops a <mono>data-site</mono> attribute when it injects a script, so this form carries the site ID in the URL instead.
settingsTracking.pauseHint: The script keeps loading and records nothing. Your domains and settings are kept
settingsTracking.rotateDescription: Every copy of the old script stops recording at once, including any you have forgotten about. You will need to paste the new tag on every page that carries the old one. Nothing already collected is lost.
settingsTracking.verifyDescription: We load one page and look for the script, then read your Tag Manager container if it is not in the HTML.
settingsTracking.verifyHint: The page has to be public. A page behind a login always fails this check.
settingsTracking.unreachableDescription: We only follow public pages, and we never follow a redirect to a private address.
settingsTracking.missingDescription: The page answered in {ms} ms, but the tag was not in the HTML. Check that it sits in the head, above anything that rewrites the page.
settingsTracking.missingContainers: {count, plural, one {We also read Tag Manager container {containers}, and the tag is not in there either.} other {We also read Tag Manager containers {containers}, and the tag is not in there either.}}
settingsTracking.dropTitle: Tag Manager will drop the site ID
settingsTracking.dropDescription: Container {id} carries the tag, but the site ID is not in the script URL. Tag Manager keeps only the URL when it injects a script, so a data-site attribute never reaches the page and the tracker never starts. Copy the Tag Manager snippet above and replace the tag's HTML.
settingsTracking.dropPageView: A page view did arrive in the last five minutes, so something on this site is still recording.
settingsTracking.foundAllowed: It answered in {ms} ms. Site ID {siteId} matched, and this domain is on the allow list.
settingsTracking.foundNotAllowed: It answered in {ms} ms. Site ID {siteId} matched, and this domain is not on the allow list.
settingsTracking.foundViaContainer: The tag is not in the HTML, so it only runs once Tag Manager fires it — a page view is the proof.
settingsTracking.foundPageView: A page view arrived in the last five minutes.
settingsTracking.foundNoPageView: No page view has arrived yet — open the page in a browser to send one.
settingsTracking.domainsDescription: The script records page views on these hosts only.
settingsTracking.domainsEmpty: Add the domain your website runs on to get your tracking script.
